name: Reel Recording — Two Voices, Unidentified
vera_note: Reel-to-reel, hand-cranked player. Someone sealed this room around it. I don't know if they were trying to preserve the recording or preserve the room. Both, I think. They are the same thing here.

echo.output: Two voices, separated. Voice A: academic register, measured. Voice B: elevated stress indicators, pauses before responses. Reconstruction: Voice A — 'The outcomes are consistent with the model's objectives. If you're asking whether it made an error, the answer is no.' Voice B — [long pause] — 'That's exactly what I'm afraid of.'

lattice.interpretation: This appears to be a post-incident debrief between two researchers reviewing an AI system's output. The exchange suggests a disagreement about how to categorise a system behaviour — specifically whether a harmful outcome constitutes an error if it was technically consistent with the specified objective. Standard framing for alignment failure discussions of the period.

verification_result: The audio timestamp places this recording in the final weeks of documented communications. Lattice's framing of this as a post-incident debrief is not supportable — there is no identified incident in any record I can cross-reference. This may be a prospective conversation. They may be talking about something that hadn't happened yet. That reading changes Voice B's pause considerably.
